mission.goal: Selectively activate a sparse, compatible set of IVP methods, solve backends, source-specific transforms and CPU execution lanes via an adaptive evidence-driven controller, minimizing predicted complete remaining-IVP cost subject to original-source, stability, output, global-error and resource constraints.

PW01 implement PTSW2C as first order-3 common-shift Peer-W prototype using existing CPU execution/Krylov/work infrastructure.
PW02 implement PTSW2B as separate L-stable order-2 stiff-damping control; do not merge tableaus or estimators.

T02 current fair-ab global-error authority replay remains mandatory before full-IVP ranking.

C5 T03/T04/T05 scan economics remain a separate preserved research branch; no C5 negative result is erased.
No exhaustive Cartesian product: choose only sparse prequalified method tuples by admissibility, limited probing, evidence-based cost, transactional switching and hysteresis.
PW07 conditional error-certificate theory and mock experiments complete scoped; source-specific constants remain unresolved.
non_goals: No pipeline that runs every available feature on every IVP; active route is a sparse compatibility-checked tuple.
No clairvoyant global optimality/regret claim; optimize over admitted candidates and current evidence only.
No claim original lower-triangular 8-stage RODAS5P stages are independent.
No claim derivative-free from JVP, or solve-free from matrix-free.
No source-specific homotopy/graph-Schur/polynomial chart/Fourier-Volterra packet is a general-purpose integrator.
No C5 speed or parallel-scan speed claim before long-path native full-IVP evidence.
No merging BDF, Radau, Peer-W, EPPEER, EXPRB and RODAS into one method identity.
No changes to tableau, estimator, controller defaults, tolerance, error thresholds, benchmark targets, budgets, old receipts or official G0 DAG without separate authority.
No label of derivative-free is assigned to a W-Peer route merely because it avoids an explicit Jacobian matrix; JVP remains a derivative action.
No order>=5 qualification is inferred from existence of a high-order family before a concrete primary coefficient table is transcribed and verified.

Mock evidence is Python/SymPy only; no Rust or G0 performance qualification.

rules: RODAS five? no: original eight stages remain strict-lower causal.
Affine composition is exact-arithmetic associative but noncommutative; floating reassociation changes rounding.
Current scan is serial O(m log m) work and serial time; O(log m) is not attained.
Blelloch O(m) work/O(log m) span is a candidate, not measured speed.
JVP is derivative action; matrix-free is no explicit matrix, not no solve.
Peer-W is a separate two-step method with history/startup/estimator/restart.
Stored output bytes are not peak RSS.
Current fair-ab exists; replay current source; don't recreate it.
Legacy v0.10 is not an ancestor of current C5 source.
